data.name: The Risen Survival
data.detailed_description:
🎥 Trailer and gameplay GIFs are coming soon!

We're currently preparing gameplay footage to showcase the action, base building, and survival mechanics. Stay tuned!

Welcome to The Risen Survival.

Fight to survive in a brutal multiplayer zombie survival world where every player is a potential ally... or your next enemy.

Scavenge abandoned locations, build and defend your base, battle hordes of infected, raid rival players, and survive against everything the world throws at you.

Whether you prefer PvP, PvE, trading, exploring, or building, there's always something to do.

The Risen Survival is a brutal multiplayer zombie survival game featuring PvP and PvE combat, land claiming and base building, 4-player co-op, terrifying Purge Nights triggered by your kills, a safe zone for trading, custom server settings, multiple map sizes, and a "learn by doing" skill system all protected by fair anti-cheat. Play on official, community, dedicated, LAN, or private servers.

A Solo Developer Passion Project

This project has been in development for over 5 years, with breaks along the way. It is being created by a solo developer driven by one goal:

To create the zombie survival game that fans of the genre have always wanted to play.

Every update is shaped by community feedback, and your support helps make continued development possible.

Thank you for being part of the journey.

Wishlist the game, gather your friends, and survive the apocalypse together.

data.short_description: The Risen Survival is an open-world survival game featuring intense PvE & PvP, base building, crafting, and relentless zombies. Gather resources, expand your base, fight for valuable loot, and compete with other players in a persistent online world

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 4GB / AMD RX 560 4GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended (large open-world streaming)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit only)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 5600 XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required for smooth loading in multiplayer

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.5+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 4GB / AMD RX 560 4GB or equivalent — Vulkan 1.1 support required
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended (large open-world streaming); requires up-to-date GPU driver (NVIDIA proprietary 470+, or Mesa/RADV 22+ for AMD)
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.5+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 5600 XT or equivalent — Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required for smooth loading in multiplayer
